title: Symbolic Rees algebras of space monomial primes of degree 5
summary: Let K be a field of characteristic 0. Let P_K(5,103,169) be the defining ideal of the space monomial curve {(t^5,t^{103},t^{169})}. In this paper we shall prove that the symbolic Rees algebra R_s(P_K(5,103,169)) is not Noetherian, that is, is not finitely generated over K.
